# Conformance fixtures

`create/` is a pinned copy of the framework R package's
`inst/conformance/create/`: for each resolved spec, the files and folders R,
Python, or `fw` write. `PreviewConformanceTest` checks the Blueprint
preview's tree against every case, so the preview shows what creation writes.

Copied from the R package's working tree on 2026-11-01, ahead of its commit.
Recopy from the release tag when the R package commits or changes them.
